company_type: Mid-cap publicly-traded green real estate developer (Mahindra Group)

technology.technology_name: 100% Green-Certified Real Estate Development Model + Integrated Cities (Net-Zero Pathway)
technology.description: Mahindra Lifespaces has maintained a 100% green portfolio since 2013 — all residential and commercial projects rated IGBC Gold or above / GRIHA 3-star or above. Operates Mahindra World City developments (Chennai, Jaipur) as integrated sustainable industrial cities. First Indian real estate firm with Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi)-approved targets, since 2019.
technology.problem_solved: Provides a replicable methodology for net-zero building portfolios — sourcing, design, materials, and operations integrated for compliance with both Indian (IGBC/GRIHA) and global (SBTi/CDP) standards.
technology.innovation_summary: Pre-2030 net-zero commitment for upcoming residential projects; signed IGBC pledge for net-zero buildings; aligned to Mahindra Group's 2040 carbon-neutral pledge.
technology.unique_selling_points: Only Indian real estate developer with SBTi approval; replicable IGBC Gold playbook; integrated city model
technology.application_area: Residential developments, commercial real estate, integrated industrial cities
technology.target_industries: Real estate developers (mid-tier looking for green playbook), city governments, industrial-park operators
technology.potential_customers: Mid-tier developers, state housing boards, Smart City SPVs
technology.patent_status: Trade-secret / process know-how; some copyrighted playbooks
technology.dsir_recognition_status: Group-level recognition through Mahindra Research Valley
technology.estimated_market_size: Green building market India: ₹30,000 Cr by 2030 (IFC estimate)
technology.royalty_expectation: 1–3% of project value typical for methodology licensing
technology.certification_status: IGBC Gold or higher (100%); GRIHA 3-star or higher (100%); SBTi-approved
